scientific_integrity: Self-review reconstruction and independent finite exhaustive computation; infinite claims proven mathematically, not inferred from checks. The classical cycle-index machinery is explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: The exact finite formula and limit apply to uniformly sampled one-successor functions with independent nondegenerate Bernoulli labels. The strict two-label size monotonicity is not asserted for more labels. Historical priority remains qualified because some classical full texts were not accessible.
title: Joint eventuality probabilities in uniformly random one-successor Kripke frames
